headword: {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}
reading: はいしゃふっかつせん

definitions.explanation: A supplementary competition that gives eliminated participants a second chance to advance, common in tournament-style competitions.

examples.japanese: {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: I advanced through the repechage round.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦{負|ま}けて→負ける：01134_makeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This tournament has a consolation round, so there's still a chance even after losing once.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一回戦|いっかいせん}→一回戦：08960_ikkaisen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{敗退|はいたい}→敗退：06840_haitai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{這|は}い{上|あ}がって→這い上がる：06269_haiagaru⟧⟦{決勝|けっしょう}→決勝：04742_kesshou⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: I was eliminated in the first round, but fought my way back through the repechage to reach the final.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{敗者|はいしゃ}→敗者：12941_haisha⟧ (loser, defeated person), ⟦{復活|ふっかつ}→復活：12565_fukkatsu⟧ (revival, comeback), and ⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧ (match, battle). This format is common in Japanese sports tournaments (⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧, ⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧, etc.), TV talent competitions, and quiz shows.

The concept is equivalent to a repechage in Western sports terminology, particularly in rowing and martial arts at the Olympics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧: to drop to the repechage bracket
- {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{勝|か}ち{上|あ}がる: to win back from the losers' bracket
- {敗者復活戦|はいしゃふっかつせん}⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}→出場：03223_shutsujou⟧: appearing in the consolation round

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予選|よせん}→予選：04745_yosen⟧: preliminary round — the initial qualifying stage, before the main competition
- ⟦{決勝戦|けっしょうせん}→決勝戦：09244_kesshousen⟧: final match — the championship round
- ⟦{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}→準決勝：04911_junkesshou⟧: semifinal — the round before the final
